items.text: Minnesota (final, game in Mexico City): OUT - QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), WR Jordan Addison (thumb surgery). QUESTIONABLE - CB Isaiah Rodgers (quad), S Jay Ward (knee). TE T.J. Hockenson full, no designation; WR Jauan Jennings expected back; LB Blake Cashman expected to play. IR - G Donovan Jackson. Kirk Cousins starts.

San Francisco (final): no outs. QUESTIONABLE (9) - WR Mike Evans (Achilles, 'a little sore', team decision Sat), LB Dre Greenlaw (neck), QB Mac Jones (illness, backup), RB Jordan James (calf), DL Khalid Kareem (ankle), LB Luke Gifford (chest), CB Upton Stout (shoulder/neck), DT CJ West and CB Nate Hobbs (both need IR activation). Brock Purdy starts.
